label: For the SAME Before/now profile, every time up to…, from Excluded middle as a general principle…
meaning: Exact old pointwise predecessor/first-time coverage under explicit excluded middle; neither ordering axioms nor temporal actuality or cardinal finiteness are smuggled in.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `∃ s, Before s t`; `TruthCore.Latin.Aquinas.SummaTheologiae.PastIsFinite Before now`. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
